newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty ends slightly up despite c.bank intervention.
newsitem.headline: Zloty ends slightly up despite c.bank intervention.

text.p: 1255 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at 1.53/1.49 pct from the trading band centre, up from Friday's 1.51/1.46 pct finish after central bank interventions drained some $45 million.
* Zloty bullish on some foreign entry into Polish T-bills and speculative currency sales to test c.bank resistance.
* It closed at 3.2390/00 to the dollar, down from 3.2385/95 on Friday and at 1.8703/13 to the mark, up from 1.8714/25.
* C.bank bought dollars at 3.2395 and 3.2405 zlotys, when zloty was about 1.55 to 1.53 pct from parity.
* Finmin Belka says May m/m CPI at 0.6 pct, yr/yr down to 14.6 pct from April's 15.3 pct, sees further CPI fall in June.
* O/N end at 21.60/21.90 pct vs opening's 22.05/22.15. T/N at 21.85/22.05 pct vs 21.95/22.15. Investors bid for 1.227 bln zlotys of Polish T-bills at 1.4 bln zloty primary auction.
